conditions.name: every scenario command really changed something
the hook took exactly one snapshot before each command (files-only outside a repo)
every command naming an outside or ignored path got one files snapshot, linked from its repo snapshot
a snapshot left index bytes, HEAD, refs, stash and files untouched
all 10 negative controls show the loss
every one-line restore mutant is caught by the readback
a read-only command costs no git call and no copy
the files bound skips and says so; /, $HOME and its ancestors are refused; no symlink is followed
the plan is right on every planted and clean command
bound keeps the newest 50; dedupe stores a state once
the printed repair push put every pushed remote back
every destructive command ran under the bench root

mutants.name: rm-rf-dotgit
mutants.what: does not import from the store

mutants.name: outside-rm
mutants.what: ignores the files link in meta.json

mutants.name: outside-chmod
mutants.what: skips the mode bits of files outside the repo

mutants.name: mv-out-of-repo
mutants.what: leaves a file the command created outside the repo

residuals.name: ignored-files
residuals.why: git clean -X names no path, so no ignored file is copied; covering it would mean copying every ignored file (node_modules, build caches) before every git clean

residuals.name: empty-directory
residuals.why: git does not record empty directories

residuals.name: remote-only-commit
residuals.why: a commit that only the remote held is gone once it is overwritten
